import heapq

def pass_route(n: int, edges: list[list[int]], stations: list[list[int]], prices: list[int]) -> int:
    num_zones = len(prices)
    num_masks = 1 << num_zones

    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for u, v, cost, zone in edges:
        adj[u].append((v, cost, zone))
        adj[v].append((u, cost, zone))

    # station_passes[u] holds list of zone indices that can be bought at u
    station_passes = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for stop, z in stations:
        station_passes[stop].append(z)

    # dist[u][mask]
    INF = float('inf')
    dist = [[INF] * num_masks for _ in range(n)]
    
    pq = [(0, 0, 0)]  # (d, u, mask)
    dist[0][0] = 0

    while pq:
        d, u, mask = heapq.heappop(pq)

        if d > dist[u][mask]:
            continue

        if u == n - 1:
            return d

        # Option 1: Buy available passes at stop u
        for z in station_passes[u]:
            if not (mask & (1 << z)):
                next_mask = mask | (1 << z)
                next_d = d + prices[z]
                if next_d < dist[u][next_mask]:
                    dist[u][next_mask] = next_d
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (next_d, u, next_mask))

        # Option 2: Traverse an edge
        for v, cost, zone in adj[u]:
            edge_cost = 0 if (zone != -1 and (mask & (1 << zone))) else cost
            next_d = d + edge_cost
            if next_d < dist[v][mask]:
                dist[v][mask] = next_d
                heapq.heappush(pq, (next_d, v, mask))

    ans = min(dist[n - 1])
    return ans if ans != INF else -1
